about_the_game:
A mesmerizing survival game with a unique atmosphere. Survive in a city that has been hit by a nuclear strike.

Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering all around you. Your goal is to escape from the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a poignant storyline. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to perish.

What awaits you in the game:

— Unique story. Along the way, you will find many stories of different people, fascinating puzzle quests and the right to choose during the passage of quests.

— Hard survival. You will be haunted by typical survivor problems such as hunger, disease, thirst, the gradually approaching nuclear winter and bandits. Eliminate enemies to survive and avoid unnecessary attention.


— Dynamic game world. In the game world, weather conditions, the alignment of forces of groups of people outside, and so on will change. Get a loyal companion who will help you in your search and protect you from danger.

— Fistfights. Engage in fierce duels with other survivors, where only strength and agility decide the outcome.

The Demo Version Is Available Now.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04.5 or equivalent
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04.2.0
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.13+
  • Processor: Intel Core2Duo E7400

short_description: Nuclear Day is a story-based role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the secrets of this world. Fight monsters. Pass tests and solve puzzles. Become your own in this tragic world.
